file.title: I have a file
file.body: Attach your 3D model to the request: the workshop checks it before replying with a personalized quote.

studio.title: I don't have a file
studio.body: Customise a vase, a business card, a coaster or a name tag in the Studio, then send it to the workshop. An idea without a file? Describe it in the form.

hints.email: The workshop replies to this address.

file.noscript: To attach a file, turn on JavaScript or write to {email}.

studioCard.noFile: No file attached: the request contains the configuration link.
studioCard.prefilled: Fields prefilled from the Studio: you can correct them.

errors.400: The file could not be read: it may be empty or damaged. Check it and try again.
errors.413: This file is larger than 30 MB. Shrink it or write to {email}.
errors.415: Unsupported format. Send an STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP file.
errors.429: Too many uploads from this connection (10 per hour). Try again later or write to {email}.
errors.network: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: The file could not be prepared. Try again, or write to {email}.

success.title: Received.
success.form: The workshop reviews your request and replies by email within 48 hours.
success.studio: The workshop checks your part and replies within 48 hours with a firm price.
